mechanism_narrative: A surge in housing starts (HOUST) above 1400K units signals increased consumer confidence, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
evidence_refs: fact:historical correlation between HOUST and consumer confidence indices
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 50% of instances when HOUST > 1400K, or Rank IC < 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals an easing monetary cycle, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When UNRATE falls below 4.0% and PAYEMS growth exceeds 200K/month, the labor market's strength signals positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 40% of instances when trigger conditions are met, or Rank IC < 0.01 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below its 6-month moving average signals reduced supply chain pressures, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.02 over any 1.5-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns during post-shock periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.10).

mechanism_narrative: Real GDP (GDPC1) growth above 3.0% YoY signals increased aggregate demand, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 45% of instances when GDPC1 growth > 3.0% YoY, or Rank IC < 0.015 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When FEDFUNDS is above 2.0% and CPIAUCSL growth exceeds 2.5% YoY, the signal indicates a tightening monetary cycle, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 55% of instances when trigger conditions are met, or Rank IC < 0.005 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in UNRATE above 5.0% signals labor market weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5d returns in > 50% of instances when UNRATE > 5.0%, or Rank IC < 0.01 over any 1.5-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in retail sales (RSAFS) below its 3-month moving average signals reduced consumer spending, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.015 over any 1.5-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns during early-cycle slowdowns are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.10).
